eyebrows.text: A study of form, before fragrance.

findings.message: 3 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 834px of the width empty: "The art".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "A presence that remains." (screen 2, 83% over a picture); "Obsidian Smoky" (screen 6, 100% over a picture); "Neroli Luminous" (screen 6, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.
